answer: Topology-diversity admission quota. New identities enter an admission lagoon where five random validators probe their egress prefix's latency signal; the contract admits on four agreeing probes, allowing 2 identities per /24 prefix and 6 per AS, rejecting excess. Every 20 epochs identities re-prove their route thread; full-prefix moves halve rewards. One broadband line serves at most 2 identities, so n sybils need n/2 ISP lines at fixed rent c: marginal cost rises linearly with n in fiat. Topology cannot be reset, split, or pre-farmed; failed replays forfeit probe deposits.
